basisOfRecord.quote: We collected 25,278 individuals belonging to 17 genera and 35 species.
Samples were collected between the months of August/2011 and May/2012.
Samples were collected during all seasons, including dry (22 to 26/VII/2011), flood (16 to 23/XI/2011), full (30/III/2012 to 03/IV/2012), and draining (14 to 23/V/2012).
For controls we used data from collections without baits which were available in a previous study in the same area (Carneiro, 2012).
